name: Going-to-the-Sun Road
description: Across Glacier National Park over Logan Pass, carved into the cliffs of the Garden Wall; open about July to mid October

description: US 129 at Deals Gap: 318 curves in 11 miles, America's most famous road for motorcycles and sports cars

name: Million Dollar Highway
description: Ouray to Silverton over Red Mountain Pass, a cliff-hugging road with no guardrails and huge drops

name: Mount Washington Auto Road
description: Private toll road to the 6,288 ft summit of the Northeast's highest peak, steep and unguarded above treeline

name: Pikes Peak Highway
description: Toll road from Cascade to the 14,115 ft summit of Pikes Peak with 156 turns, home of the hill climb race

name: Angeles Crest Highway
description: La Cañada Flintridge through the San Gabriel Mountains to Wrightwood, Los Angeles' favourite mountain drive

name: Ortega Highway
description: Twisting climb from San Juan Capistrano over the Santa Ana Mountains to Lake Elsinore

name: Skyline Boulevard
description: Ridge-top road down the Santa Cruz Mountains above Silicon Valley, a classic Bay Area weekend drive

name: Moki Dugway
description: Gravel switchbacks cut into a 1,100 ft cliff above the Valley of the Gods near Mexican Hat

name: Oak Creek Canyon
description: From Sedona up red-rock Oak Creek Canyon and the switchbacks to Flagstaff

name: Twisted Sisters
description: Ranch roads 335, 336 and 337 through the Texas Hill Country canyons around Leakey, a motorcycle favourite

name: Pig Trail
description: Arkansas Highway 23 through the Ozark National Forest, tunnelled by trees and full of bends

name: Hana Highway
description: Maui's road to Hāna with 620 curves and 59 one-lane bridges past waterfalls and rainforest
